                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ତାପଗ୍ରାହୀ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଏକ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଯାହା ଏହାର ଚତୁଃପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରୁ ଉତ୍ତାପ ଶୋଷଣ କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଅନେକ ବିଘଟନ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାର ବୈଶିଷ୍ଟ୍ୟ, ନିରନ୍ତର ଉତ୍ତାପ ଯୋଗାଣ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • ଚୂନଭାଟି:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଚୂନପଥର (କ୍ୟାଲସିୟମ୍ କାର୍ବୋନେଟ୍) ର କାଲସାଇନେସନ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା କ୍ୱିକ୍‌ଲାଇମ୍ ଉତ୍ପାଦନ ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଏକ ଭାଟି।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ଉଚ୍ଚ ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ, ସାଧାରଣତଃ ପ୍ରାୟ 900-1000°C ରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n14a:Tc64,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is Double displacement reaction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In a double displacement reaction, the ions of two compounds exchange places in an aqueous solution to form two new compounds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The general form of a double displacement reaction is AB + CD → AD + CB.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The reaction CuSO4 + 2NaOH → Cu(OH)2 + Na2SO4 involves the exchange of ions between copper sulfate (CuSO4) and sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This type of reaction is typically characterized by the formation of a precipitate, gas, or a weak electrolyte.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Double displacement reactions are also known as metathesis reactions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Precipitation Reaction\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          નીચે આપેલ સમીકરણ કયા પ્રકારની પ્રક્રિયાનું ઉદાહરણ છે?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          CuSO4 + 2NaOH → Cu(OH)2 + Na2SO4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "દહન પ્રક્રિયા"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "સંયોગીકરણ પ્રક્રિયા"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "દ્વિ-વિસ્થાપન પ્રક્રિયા"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "તટસ્થીકરણ પ્રક્રિયા"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "kn": {"value": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಕೆಳಗಿನ ಸಮೀಕರಣವು ಯಾವ ರೀತಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಾಗಿದೆ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          CuSO4 + 2NaOH → Cu(OH)2 + Na2SO4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          கீழ்க்கண்ட சமன்பாடு எந்த வகையான வினைக்கு ஒரு எடுத்துக்காட்டு?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          CuSO4 + 2NaOH → Cu(OH)2 + Na2SO4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "எரிதல் வினை"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "சேர்க்கை வினை"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "இரட்டை இடப்பெயர்ச்சி வினை"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "நடுநிலைப்படுத்தும் வினை"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "or": {"value": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ସମୀକରଣ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାର ଉଦାହରଣ?

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          CuSO4 + 2NaOH → Cu(OH)2 + Na2SO4

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "ଦହନ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "ମିଳିତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "ଦ୍ୱୈତ ବିସ୍ଥାପନ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "ନିରପେକ୍ଷକରଣ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Double displacement reaction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In a double displacement reaction, the ions of two compounds exchange places in an aqueous solution to form two new compounds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The general form of a double displacement reaction is AB + CD → AD + CB.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • The reaction CuSO4 + 2NaOH → Cu(OH)2 + Na2SO4 involves the exchange of ions between copper sulfate (CuSO4) and sodium hydroxide (NaOH).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • This type of reaction is typically characterized by the formation of a precipitate, gas, or a weak electrolyte.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Double displacement reactions are also known as metathesis reactions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Precipitation Reaction\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A type of double displacement reaction where an insoluble solid called a precipitate forms and separates from the solution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: AgNO3 + NaCl → AgCl (precipitate) + NaNO3.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Neutralization Reaction\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A specific type of double displacement reaction where an acid reacts with a base to produce water and a salt.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: HCl + NaOH → NaCl + H2O.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Combustion Reaction\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A chemical reaction where a substance combines with oxygen to release energy in the form of heat and light.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: CH4 + 2O2 → CO2 + 2H2O.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Combination Reaction\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A reaction where two or more substances combine to form a single new substance.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: 2H2 + O2 → 2H2O.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Displacement Reaction\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • A reaction where a more reactive element displaces a less reactive element from its compound.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Example: Zn + CuSO4 → ZnSO4 + Cu.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
